decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several backpack types including large internal frame packs, sling bags, and sports-specific options. While the Mardingtop was impressive in capacity, specific negative reviews regarding material quality and refund issues were a deterrent. The Maxpedition Prepared Citizen Classic stood out due to its high durability, discreet design for everyday carry, and consistently positive customer feedback regarding its comfort and build quality. Compared to the mid-range hiking options with reported durability flaws like strap tearing (Hebetag), the Maxpedition offered a higher standard of reliability for daily use.
